label: One 135-line file with two credential-handling defects

origin.note: The target every earlier measurement used, so it is the only case with continuity back to the pre-benchmark record. Reviewed with --file, exactly as those runs were.

defects.description: normalizeBaseUrl rebuilds the URL from origin + path, silently discarding any credentials embedded in it and any query string. One bug with two symptoms, fixed in one change.
resolveProfile spreads the named profile — including its API key — while overriding baseUrl, so a credential for one host is sent as a Bearer token to an unrelated origin.

dropped.claim: A mistyped --provider was accepted when --base-url was also given, disarming the size guard.
dropped.reason: Sits on line 119, the same line as credential-inherited-across-origin. An anchor match cannot tell the two apart, so listing both would credit one finding twice.
